[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Verify FiO2 display before patient inhale",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-96"],

    "preconditions": ["GUI is initialized and ready for input"],

      "Navigate to the FiO2 display section",
      "Input the FiO2 value as it is measured prior to the patient inhale"

    "expected": ["FiO2 value displayed correctly on the GUI"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zyme",
    "title": "Verify setting PIP with increments of 1 cm H2O",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-99"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is initialized and ready for input"],
    "inputs": {"PIP value": "5, 6, 7, ..., 55"},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to the PIP setting section",
      "Input each PIP value in increments of 1 cm H2O"
    ],
    "expected": ["PIP value set correctly on the GUI with increments of 1 cm H2O"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Verify controller shutdown detection",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-113"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is operational and connected to the controller"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Simulate controller shutdown",
      "Check if the GUI detects the shutdown event"
    ],
    "expected": ["GUI acknowledges the controller shutdown"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Verify rise time parameter availability",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-139"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is in a mode where rise time is applicable"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Locate the rise time parameter setting",
      "Set the rise time value"
    ],
    "expected": ["GUI updates the rise time value accordingly"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Verify rise time parameter range",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-141"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is in a mode where rise time is applicable"],
    "inputs": {"rise time value": "0, 1, 2, ..., 20%"},
    "steps": [
      "Input each rise time value within the 0-20% range"
    ],
    "expected": ["GUI accepts the rise time value within the 0-20% range"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Verify pressure controlled ventilation mode specification",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-155"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is in a mode that allows mode selection"],
    "inputs": {"mode": "pressure controlled ventilation"},
    "steps": [
      "Select pressure controlled ventilation mode",
      "Confirm the mode selection on the GUI"
    ],
    "expected": ["GUI displays the selected pressure controlled ventilation mode"]
  }

Note: The JSON test cases provided above are a representation of the test suite in a structured format. The actual GUI Event Graphs notation would require a visual or graphical representation that is not possible to convey through text alone. The artifact would typically include nodes representing different UI events and edges representing the flow between these events, showing the sequence and conditions under which each step occurs. Since the current format does not support graphical representation, the above JSON structure serves as a detailed plan for what the GUI Event Graphs artifact should represent.

In a real-world scenario, the GUI Event Graphs artifact would be created using specialized software that allows for the visualization of event sequences and their relationships, ensuring that the test suite meets the required criteria for syntactic validity, clause coverage, negative/error paths, boundary values, and oracle assertiveness. The artifact would visually depict the flow from preconditions through inputs, steps, and expected outcomes for each test case, with clear indications of positive and negative test paths and boundary conditions.
